60 Minutes Season Premiere Ratings Hit 25-Year Low

The season premiere of the CBS news program '60 Minutes' has recorded its lowest ratings in 25 years. This decline is being analyzed in the context of a recent overhaul of the program. Reports indicate that the show's performance is facing challenges.
